concept: A position on a short ordered scale: a channel cut into steps with a bead at the value, a ring to compare with and a band between them.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a Scale drawn as a gold progress bar with a red or green number beside it
default_to_avoid.kind: scale, level indicator, rank track, segmented meter
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured bar says better or worse by hue alone and hides the steps; Pane shows the steps, a bead and an arrow with words

references.title: WAI-ARIA img role and accessible names

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the steps are the slider channel carved into the pane and the bead is the slider bead lit from above

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the value is a solid bead, the comparison a hollow ring, and an arrow points the way the value moved

derivation.consequence: status is spoken in text as well as shown in colour
derivation.form: the band between ring and bead takes the positive or critical mark, and the word at the end says the level

options: A stepped channel, bead and ring
variants.picked: A stepped channel, bead and ring
variants.reason: A shows the steps and both positions by shape (P6) on the slider material (P3). B rests on hue. C cannot show a value between steps or a comparison.

root.why: the label, the channel and the word share one row in three columns

bare.why: a bare scale is only the channel, for a table cell or a row that already names it

label.why: the label is at label size in the primary tone and wraps instead of spilling

word.why: the word for the level is medium weight at the end of the row with its arrow

track.why: the steps sit in one row on a line the bead and the ring share

step.why: each step is a piece of the slider channel carved into the pane

on.why: steps up to the value are lit so the level reads before the bead is found

band.why: the band between the ring and the bead shows how far the value moved

good.why: a move the right way takes the positive mark

bad.why: a move the wrong way takes the critical mark

ring.why: the comparison is a hollow ring so it never reads as the value

dot.why: the value is the slider bead lit from above; it is too small to glow, so it reads by shape alone

arrow.why: an arrow beside the word points up or down the way the value moved

down.why: a fall turns the same arrow over so up and down are one glyph

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the steps, the bead and the ring so the position stays findable
